# mtncloud_spec_template (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud spec template data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_spec_template" "mtncloud_template" {
  name = "tf vpc spec template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the spec template

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
